description: Wave F: Final Certification Sequence - Implement agents 13-15 (Final Evidence Freeze, Final Gate Controller aggregating 14 gates, Human Certification). Update orchestration to execute complete 15-agent DAG with parallel gates. This completes the certification workflow.
steps: Create services/project-ai/app/agents/final_evidence_freeze.py with execute_final_evidence_freeze(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Reads all evidence from prior agents (foundation + candidate pipeline + gate results). Validates evidence binding to commit_sha + snapshot_hash. Checks no orphaned evidence, no duplicate IDs. Freezes final evidence set. Returns AgentResult with outputs: total_evidence_count, binding_valid, all_evidence_ids

Extend services/project-ai/app/agents/final_gate.py FinalGateAgent to aggregate ALL 14 gate results (CONTRACT, ILS, LSNB, RSSB, UBRC, REGISTRY, RENDERER, COMPOSER, TESTS, RUNTIME, BROWSER, BRAND_INDEPENDENCE, THEME_COMPATIBILITY, EVIDENCE). NOTE: ILS, LSNB, RSSB deferred to Phase 2, so aggregate 11 gates in MVP. Check all gates passed. Generate FinalCertification with verdict CERTIFICATION_READY if all pass, FAIL if any fail, BLOCKED if missing evidence. Return AgentResult with outputs: final_certification (FinalCertification), verdict, gate_summary

Create services/project-ai/app/agents/human_certification.py with execute_human_certification(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Reads FinalCertification from Agent 14. Implements human review workflow similar to approval.py but for final certification. Polls database table certification_reviews with fields: certification_id, decision (CERTIFIED/REJECTED/PENDING), reviewer, reviewed_at, comments. Timeout from env var PROJECT_AI_CERTIFICATION_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 86400). Returns AgentResult with outputs: human_decision, reviewer, comments

Update services/project-ai/app/orchestration/workflow_engine.py to use workflow_dag.py AGENT_WORKFLOW_DAG for execution. Replace existing step-based workflow with DAG-based execution. Call agent_coordinator.execute_dag() with DAG from workflow_dag.py. Handle sequential agents (01-11, 13-15) and parallel gates (12A-12J in parallel_group 'certification-gates')

Update services/project-ai/app/orchestration/agent_coordinator.py execute_dag() method to handle parallel execution groups. When agent has parallel_group attribute, collect all agents in same group and execute with execute_parallel(). Ensure certification gates (12A-12J) all run in parallel after agent 11 completes

Create database schema for certification_reviews table: certification_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, final_certification JSON NOT NULL, requested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, decision TEXT CHECK(decision IN ('PENDING','CERTIFIED','REJECTED','TIMEOUT')), reviewer TEXT, reviewed_at TIMESTAMP, comments TEXT
Create tests/agents/test_final_evidence_freeze.py with test cases: test_evidence_aggregation_success, test_binding_validation, test_duplicate_detection, test_orphaned_evidence_detection

Update tests/agents/test_final_gate.py to cover 14-gate aggregation (or 11 in MVP): test_all_gates_pass_certification_ready, test_any_gate_fail_verdict_fail, test_missing_evidence_blocked, test_gate_summary_generation, test_final_certification_json

Create tests/agents/test_human_certification.py with test cases: test_certification_pending, test_certification_certified, test_certification_rejected, test_certification_timeout, test_reviewer_workflow

Create tests/orchestration/test_workflow_dag_execution.py with test cases: test_sequential_agents_execute_in_order, test_parallel_gates_execute_concurrently, test_dependency_resolution, test_gate_failure_blocks_final_certification, test_full_dag_execution_success, test_dag_execution_with_blocked_agent
Update services/project-ai/app/orchestration/agent_registry.py to register: FINAL_EVIDENCE_FREEZE, FINAL_GATE_CONTROLLER (extend existing FINAL_GATE), HUMAN_CERTIFICATION

Create integration test tests/integration/test_full_certification_workflow.py that exercises complete 15-agent DAG from repository audit through human certification. Uses fixtures for snapshot, candidate, approvals. Validates evidence flow, gate execution, final certification generation
acceptance_criteria: Final Evidence Freeze aggregates all evidence from prior agents and validates binding
Final Gate Controller aggregates 14 gate results (or 11 in MVP) and generates FinalCertification with correct verdict
Human Certification implements database polling workflow for final review
Workflow engine executes DAG-based orchestration using AGENT_WORKFLOW_DAG
Agent coordinator handles parallel execution groups for certification gates
All agent test files created with comprehensive coverage
DAG execution tests validate sequential and parallel execution patterns
Integration test validates complete end-to-end workflow
Agent registry updated with final agents
verification: cd services/project-ai && python -c 'from app.agents.final_evidence_freeze import execute_final_evidence_freeze; from app.agents.human_certification import execute_human_certification; print("Final agents import OK")'
cd services/project-ai && python -c 'from app.orchestration.workflow_dag import AGENT_WORKFLOW_DAG; from app.orchestration.workflow_engine import WorkflowEngine; print("DAG orchestration OK")'
findings: Implemented complete 15-agent DAG workflow with final certification sequence. All core tests passing. Pre-existing certification gate test failures are unrelated to FEAT-005 implementation.
